name: SKS City Mall JBCC
note: New mall under the Sheraton, minutes from the Causeway checkpoint, with more shops opening through 2026.

name: Horizon Mall
note: Open-air, greenery-heavy lifestyle mall about ten minutes from Legoland; opened with 13 food outlets.

name: Sunway Puteri Hills
note: Hilltop open-air dining hub with strait views and 13 dining spaces; more outlets due late 2026.

name: Danga Park
note: Waterfront park with giant themed playgrounds, water play and night lights; foreigners pay an entry fee.

name: Kiztopia at Toppen
note: Singapore-born indoor play and edutainment centre for kids, with obstacle courses and role-play zones.

name: KIPMall Tampoi (revamped)
note: Older neighbourhood mall that reopened after a major revamp, 15 to 20 minutes from the checkpoint.

name: Guan Heong 1918 at the Red House
note: Heritage biscuit and pastry shop, paired with a Nanyang cafe, inside the Red House landmark.

name: Festival Orkid Johor Bahru 2026
note: Five-day city council orchid festival with floral displays, plant collections and gardening activities.

name: Johor Furniture Fair
note: Weekend furniture fair in the Mid Valley Exhibition Centre halls on the mall's third floor.

name: Pet Expo Johor Bahru (Christmas Edition)
note: Three-day pet products fair, 11am to 9pm, with a small entry fee for adults.

name: Legends Vibe: Live in JB
note: Tamil music concert headlined by Suresh Peters, his first Johor Bahru show.

name: Brick-Tacular Holiday at Legoland
note: Christmas season in the theme park with festive shows, Santa meet-ups and New Year drone shows.

name: B.DUCK City Funs
note: Duck-themed evening funfair in the AEON car park, closed Tuesdays, running until April 2027.
